name: Natasha Flores
source:
Natasha was born in Monterrey, Mexico on February 27th, 2012. Due to her parents’ divorce, she ended up moving to Brookdale with her father at a very young age. She holds no bitter feelings to her mother and will visit her pretty often. Natasha is a very popular streamer that specializes in JRPGs and loves cosplaying anime characters. Her favorite anime of all time is 86. She has an older brother and a younger sister who moved to Brookdale recently, though they don’t live together. Natasha dreams of making her own video game, which led her to pursuing a degree in Game Design at Brookdale U.
